queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    position,
    driver_name,
    driver_code,
    team_name,
    grid_position,
    positions_gained,
    time_or_gap,
    points,
    case when best_lap_s is not null
         then printf('%d:%06.3f', floor(best_lap_s / 60)::int, best_lap_s - 60 * floor(best_lap_s / 60)) end as best_lap,
    driver_link
from f1.results
where meeting_key = ${params.meeting}
  and session_name = '${inputs.session}'
order by position nulls last, number_of_laps desc

queries.compiledQueryString:
select l.lap_number, l.driver_code, l.team_colour, l.gap_to_leader_s
from f1.laps l
join f1.results r
  on r.meeting_key = l.meeting_key
 and r.session_name = l.session_name
 and r.driver_code = l.driver_code
where l.meeting_key = ${params.meeting}
  and l.session_name = '${inputs.session}'
  and r.position <= 10
  and l.gap_to_leader_s is not null
order by l.lap_number

queries.compiledQueryString:

    st.driver_code,
    'Stint ' || st.stint_number || ' · ' || st.compound as stint,
    st.stint_length_laps,
    r.position
from f1.stints st
join f1.results r
  on r.meeting_key = st.meeting_key
 and r.session_name = st.session_name
 and r.driver_code = st.driver_code
where st.meeting_key = ${params.meeting}
  and st.session_name = '${inputs.session}'
order by r.position nulls last, st.stint_number

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    compound,
    case compound when 'SOFT' then 1 when 'MEDIUM' then 2 when 'HARD' then 3 else 4 end as compound_order,
    round(median(deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap), 3) as deg_s_per_lap,
    count(*) as stints
from f1.stints
where meeting_key = ${params.meeting}
  and session_name = '${inputs.session}'
  and clean_laps >= 5
  and deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap is not null
group by compound
order by compound_order
queries.inputQueryString:

    round(median(deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap), 3) as deg_s_per_lap,
    count(*) as stints
from f1.stints
where meeting_key = ${params.meeting}
  and session_name = '${inputs.session}'
  and clean_laps >= 5
  and deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap is not null
group by compound
